motivation: Separate genuine high-evidence foodplant associations that are not in frozen HOSTS from simple nomenclatural synonyms/formatting differences.

input.BCE: All 92 butterfly original page records with species-level BCE-only exact plant spellings, based on BCE-derived Clarke evidence tiers 1-3

matching.butterfly: Exactly frozen binomial; do not silently lump synonymous butterfly species
matching.plant: First require unique accepted species name match; otherwise unique synonym accepted species ID, otherwise report unmatched/ambiguous. Do not map generic or infraspecific names to species without explicit taxonomy.
matching.baseline: Use fixed E x accepted plant ID sidecar from original HOSTS/WCVP builder; no new network edges added to main manuscript.
matching.endpoint: Among BCE-only exact names, count uniquely taxon-resolved links already present in HOSTS after synonymy vs uniquely resolved links still absent, plus unresolved and ambiguous; list names and accepted IDs.
matching.denominator: Do not use all 92 or all BCE links as if they were independent field events; report matched sites and taxonomic resolution, and this source's attrition.

stop: Do not equate source bibliographic evidence 1-3 with adult emergence or local realized fitness
Do not assume true missingness for unmatched names or butterfly synonym cases
Do not rerun GEB main inference, or promote any revised native/contemporary area effects without separate missing-host geography sensitivity and unbiased coverage
Do not claim statistical independent reference because original primary references may overlap
